project_name: AI Dynamic Pricing & Revenue Management Simulator (Hotel)
archetype: OBSIDIAN & CHAMPAGNE GOLD (Performance Pro & Luxury Fusion)

hierarchy.kpi_hero: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-amber-400 font-mono
hierarchy.h2_section: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold text-amber-200 tracking-wide uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-slate-400

layout_structure.mode: Single-screen 3-zone dashboard optimized for live MBA classroom projector presentation

header.description: Sticky top bar with Luxury Hotel Branding ('The Grand Horizon Palace - Mumbai'), live simulator clock, Currency indicator (INR ₹), Presenter Mode toggle with glowing pulse, Strategy Sheet Print button, and Scenario Reset
header.container_classes: h-16 px-6 bg-[#0B0E14]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#232A3B] flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40

left_zone.name: Zone 1: Scenario Inputs & Shocks Panel
components: Market Condition Sliders: Base Demand Index (0-200), Capacity Remaining % (0-100%), Days-to-Arrival (1-90 days), Season Selector (Peak / High / Shoulder / Low), Competitor Avg Rate (₹), Event Flag Toggle
Preset Demand Shock Buttons: 'Monsoon Slump (-30%)', 'IPL Championship Match (+55%)', 'Tech Summit 2026 (+40%)', 'Flight Cancellation Crisis (+25%)'

center_zone.name: Zone 2: Rule-Based Optimizer & Monte Carlo Engine
components: Recommended Price Hero Card: Big ₹ ADR with percentage surge badge (+24.5%), Revenue Impact P50 (₹ Lakhs), and Quick Apply Button
14-Day Demand Forecast & Booking Pace Line Chart (Recharts / SVG gradient area curve)
Price Multipliers Breakdown Table/Accordion (Base Rate, Lead Time Factor, Capacity Scarcity Factor, Competitor Benchmark Factor, Event Surge Factor)
Customer Monte Carlo Simulation Card: Revenue Distribution Histogram with P10 / P50 / P90 quantile pills, Projected Occupancy %, Conversion Rate %
3-Way Rate Comparison Table (Current Rate vs Recommended Rate vs Competitor Rate)

right_zone.name: Zone 3: AI Explanation & Ethical Policy Guardrails
components: Ethical & Policy Warnings Box (Amber non-blocking flags: Surge cap >40% alert, Festival gouging advisory, OTA channel parity check, with mitigation actions)
LLM Explanation Card ('Why this price?', 'Key market risks', 'Alternative strategy option', interactive AI prompt input box & Re-Generate Insights button)
Printable Strategy Export Preview trigger modal

key_features_to_implement: Interactive Scenario Input Sliders with smooth realtime calculation triggers
Preset Shock Buttons with immediate visual feedback, subtle sound/flash effect, and badge indicator
Dynamic 14-Day Forecast Line Chart and Booking Pace Area Chart with dual tooltip comparative metrics
Hero Recommended Price Card featuring massive 60px INR text visible from 20 feet away on a classroom projector
Monte Carlo Revenue Simulation Histogram with smooth frequency distribution bars and interactive P10/P50/P90 markers
Amber Ethical Warning Flags (strictly amber #F59E0B badges and border glow, non-blocking with clear recommendations)
LLM Explanation Card with typewriter or smooth streaming effect for plain-English explanation, risk breakdown, and alternative recommendations
3-Way Comparison View (Current vs Recommended vs Competitor) with delta indicators (₹ and %)
Presenter Mode Auto-Walkthrough: Interactive guided modal overlay with spotlight focus, step-by-step audio/narrative cues for MBA lectures
Printable Strategy Export: Clean, black-and-white print-optimized strategy executive summary sheet (opens print dialog or full page print layout)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-featured single-screen dashboard with high visual polish, obsidian background (#080A0F), subtle glassmorphism cards (#11151E), and gold/amber accents.
Ensure all currency displays use Indian Rupees (₹) e.g., ₹18,450 or ₹14.2 Lakhs.
Ensure numbers for Recommended Price, P50 Revenue, and Occupancy % are huge (text-5xl or text-6xl) so they are readable on a projector from the back of a classroom.
Keep ethical policy warnings strictly AMBER (#F59E0B), framed as non-blocking alerts with actionable mitigation strategies.
Include dynamic Math/Simulation engine for Monte Carlo distribution (1000 simulated iterations producing P10, P50, P90 revenue stats, conversion rate, and occupancy).
Implement Presenter Mode auto-walkthrough with step-by-step highlighted modal spotlights for classroom teaching.
Add printable strategy export layout that generates a clean executive summary document when clicked.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive controls and key metrics.
